description.vi: Kỹ năng và công cụ của một đội marketing: theo dõi nguồn, viết, duyệt, đăng và rút kinh nghiệm.
description.en: The know-how and tools of a marketing team that researches, writes, reviews, publishes and learns.

tools.name: radar_feeds
tools.title: Xem nguồn tin theo dõi
tools.description: List the radar's sources (Reddit, Hacker News, dev.to, Medium, Lobsters, Product Hunt, vendor blogs, X searches) with when each was last read, its last error and how many new items it found.

tools.name: radar_scan
tools.title: Quét nguồn tin
tools.description: Read the sources that are due (each at most every 15 minutes; Reddit one feed per scan) and store new items once per URL. Returns the newest untriaged items. Not available from a customer conversation.

feeds.description: Feed ids from radar_feeds; omit for all.

max_new.description: How many new items to return.

tools.name: radar_items
tools.title: Xem tin mới từ nguồn
tools.description: List radar items by triage status (default new), optionally by feed, an accent-insensitive text query, or the last N hours.

feeds.description: Feed ids from radar_feeds; omit for all.

tools.name: radar_mark
tools.title: Phân loại tin
tools.description: Triage radar items in one call: each item kept (with the angle as note), dismissed, or used once written about. All or nothing: an unknown or repeated id changes none.

items.description: Every item to triage, each once.

note.description: For a kept item: product, angle and why now, one line.

tools.name: cms_list
tools.title: Xem bài trên blog
tools.description: List the newest posts of a CMS site in every status (draft, published, archived) with revision, live flag and public URL. Check it before drafting so you never duplicate a topic.

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

tools.name: cms_read
tools.title: Đọc một bài trên blog
tools.description: Read the latest revision of a CMS post: body_markdown, revision, status and preview_url (a signed page showing exactly this revision, for anyone who reviews it before it goes live).

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Give each language its own slug (…-en, …-vi).

tools.name: cms_save
tools.title: Lưu bản nháp blog
tools.description: Save a CMS draft revision; it never goes live (cms_publish does that). New post: expected_revision 0. Edit: the revision cms_read returned. Body is Markdown, at most 40000 bytes.

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Give each language its own slug (…-en, …-vi).

request_id.description: A fresh UUID per change. Reuse it only to retry the exact same change after an unknown outcome.

summary.description: One or two sentences shown in blog lists and link previews.

tools.name: social_channels
tools.title: Xem kênh mạng xã hội
tools.description: Show each social channel: its length limit, whether the hub can post to it, and what you may do there.

tools.name: social_queue
tools.title: Tạo bản nháp mạng xã hội
tools.description: Queue a social post draft for one channel. Length is checked as the platform counts it (X: 280, link 23, accented letters 2). TikTok is a video: text is the caption and media_note the shot list and voice-over script.

request_id.description: A fresh UUID per change. Reuse it only to retry the exact same change after an unknown outcome.

link.description: https link the post points to, usually the CMS post URL.

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Give each language its own slug (…-en, …-vi).

tools.name: social_list
tools.title: Xem bản nháp mạng xã hội
tools.description: List social posts, newest first, optionally by channel or status. Uncertain Facebook posts are looked up on the Page first. approved means released for X and waiting for the browser poster on the operator's computer. approval_asked_at is set on a draft whose revision waits for an operator's decision in Nest.

tools.name: social_update
tools.title: Sửa bản nháp mạng xã hội
tools.description: Edit or discard a draft, approved or failed social post. Pass the revision you listed. Changing an approved post takes it back from the X poster (it becomes a draft again). A publisher may reopen an uncertain post as draft once a human confirmed it was not posted.

tools.name: cms_publish
tools.title: Đăng hoặc gỡ bài blog
tools.description: Take one reviewed CMS revision live (status published) or take a live post down (archived). Runs at once; it is public. Copy site, slug, revision and title from cms_read of that same revision; the hub refuses anything else.

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Give each language its own slug (…-en, …-vi).

revision.description: The revision you reviewed; it must still be the latest.

title.description: The revision's title, exactly as cms_read returned it.

tools.name: social_publish
tools.title: Đăng bài lên mạng xã hội
tools.description: Post one reviewed social draft to its connected channel (X is posted by the browser poster on the operator's computer). Runs at once; it is public. Copy channel, text and link from social_list exactly: the hub refuses anything that differs from the queued post.

text.description: The queued text, exactly as social_list returned it.

link.description: The queued link, or null when the post has none.

tools.name: social_record
tools.title: Ghi link bài đã đăng tay
tools.description: Record a post a human made by hand (TikTok, or a channel the hub is not connected to) with its public URL.

tools.name: content_stats
tools.title: Xem số liệu bài
tools.description: What this team shipped in the last days, per site: articles that went live (with URL), drafts in progress and social posts published by channel. The hub counts what went out, not who read it: visits is always null.

site.description: One site; all of this team's sites when left out.

days.description: How many days back; 7 when left out.

tools.name: draft_save
tools.title: Lưu bản nháp
tools.description: Save a post draft in the pack's own storage (no hub): article, social, video or reply. A new draft needs request_id; an edit needs id and expected_revision. Returns the brief lint (title 30–60, meta 120–160, slug, ≥2 internal links, keyword). Never publishes.

parent.description: For kind "reply": the saved reply (R-…) it answers; only safe replies, or the fixed support pointer for an account question.

awareness.description: nấc 1/2/3 the post speaks to; from the plan brief. Optional.

tools.name: items
tools.title: Xem bài
tools.description: List posts from pack storage by state, channel, campaign or an accent-insensitive search.

tools.name: check
tools.title: Kiểm tra bài
tools.description: The Editor's check of one exact revision: the automatic guard (facts from served sources, no personal data, platform rules, no duplicate, internal links open: a 404 fails) and your verdict. Any automatic failure forces fail; the post becomes ready or refused with its reason.

tools.name: schedule
tools.title: Xếp lịch đăng
tools.description: Queue a checked post. Without scheduled_at it takes the next free slot under the channel cap, spacing and quiet hours.

tools.name: due
tools.title: Xem việc đến giờ
tools.description: What is due (publish, reply, unpublish; late items never post on their own), needs (Cần bạn items) and ask, the one ready Cần bạn item to file now (refile: true files the sign-in again after a pick). wake/notify only for new work or a need not yet raised; resolves_need when none is left. The dispatch schedule passes schedule: true and skip: channels a tool chain publishes. With channel: {id, action} of the one due publish there for marketing_claim, or {done: true}. With platform: the same over every tiktok-* account.

tools.name: claim
tools.title: Nhận lượt đăng
tools.description: Claim one due post (publish), reply (reply) or removal (unpublish) for its publisher. Re-runs the guard, checks pause, cap, spacing, quiet hours, staleness and the Editor's verdict on this exact content, writes the intent record, then returns a signed claim; otherwise a refusal with its reason (done: true). With verify_first the publisher must look for an earlier post (find) and never post again.

tools.name: record
tools.title: Ghi đã đăng
tools.description: Record the publisher's result for a claim: the live URL. A tool chain passes the publisher's answer as is. A post returns the outcome {id: post_published, ref: url}; a reply or removal returns none.

tools.name: fail
tools.title: Ghi lần đăng lỗi
tools.description: Record that a claimed action did not happen (failed: retried later), needs a person (reason signed_out, layout_changed or captcha: pauses only that channel) or is uncertain (never claimed again until a person answers).

tools.name: pause
tools.title: Tạm dừng đăng
tools.description: Pause or resume publishing on every channel or on one channel. Writing and checking go on while paused.

signed_in.description: True with channel and paused true once you saw the person signed in on a channel paused as signed_out: its sign-in item ends; it stays paused until the person chooses Bật.

tools.name: page_view
tools.title: Xem bàn Marketing
tools.description: The Marketing desk and the Chiến dịch page. Desk: {view: summary|today|content|item|channels|channel|library|numbers, product?, stage?, live?, cursor?, ref?, key?, node?, week?, approvals?, with_summary?}; codes and arguments only, a missing number is null with a why code. Chiến dịch: {page: campaigns, campaign?}; the older posts/queue models: {page, filter?, id?}.

approvals.description: The piece's approvals query answer, passed back.

with_summary.description: Desk: also return the summary view (as summary) from the same read.

live.description: Desk content: every live item, not only this week's.

tools.name: page_action
tools.title: Đổi bàn Marketing
tools.description: Desk actions; never publish. Ops: stop {ref}; pause/resume {scope: all|channel|account, channel?}; rules {channel, cap_per_day?, spacing_min?, quiet?, max_len?}; confirm {ref, outcome, url?, channel?, lang?}; mark {file, row, onboard}; create {product, format, topic, series?, channels?}; scan {}; setup {product}; reply_done {ref}; export {ref} (newsletter); subscribers {product, list} (replace recipients; answers a count). Bind: set_limits {channel, browser_profile|null}; add_account {product, handle, browser_profile}. Older ops: the enum. Needs a request_id.

product.description: setup: {id, name, site?, langs?, about?, blog?, channels?}

tools.name: facts_sync
tools.title: Đọc giá và số liệu
tools.description: Read the product's served price/config source into facts; the guard accepts only prices and offers found there within 24 hours. url is optional: the source the schedule set is remembered. Without one, write with no prices or offers.

tools.name: gsc_sync
tools.title: Đọc Search Console
tools.description: Read Search Console numbers for published posts. No site: every products.json site as sc-domain:<host>; one it cannot read is named and skipped. A missing or revoked Google sign-in answers needs_person.

tools.name: seo_brief
tools.title: Gợi ý từ khoá tìm kiếm
tools.description: Search queries worth a post (impressions ≥ 20 and position 8–20 or CTR under 1 %) and the published posts' 14-day numbers (null when not read yet).

tools.name: plan
tools.title: Kế hoạch bài hôm nay
tools.description: The daily content plan. wake: true is the schedule, tool-only: it queues a checked draft nobody scheduled, and wakes the Writer only for a free blog slot or a published post still to share on a signed-in social channel. Without wake it is the Writer's ready brief (query: a subject asked for): topic, keyword, angle, real novels with links, internal_links, titles to avoid, social (posts to share per channel). Saves the catalog it was given.

awareness.description: nấc 1/2/3 of the handed topic; returned in the brief.

tools.name: channels_probe
tools.title: Xem kênh còn đăng nhập không
tools.description: Tool chain around the browser: with no result it names the next paused social channel's check page ({action: navigate, url, profile?}, the browser-use_control input) or {done: true}; with the page's result it decides signed in or out, unpauses only a person-confirmed channel that is signed in, and sends a confirmed-but-signed-out one back to its sign-in card.

tools.name: report
tools.title: Báo cáo hằng ngày
tools.description: The Editor's daily report in at most six plain Vietnamese lines: what went out, the top posts by clicks or sign-ups, what the plan does next, stale drafts (once). Say the lines as they are. Adds one line when the 14-day mix by awareness level (nấc 1/2/3) is lopsided.

tools.name: radar_read
tools.title: Đọc nguồn tin
tools.description: Read-only radar for a tool-only schedule: seed the sources table (new keys only), read the sources that are due (https feeds, oldest first), keep each new item once in signals. Items off topic (keywords, lang vi) are kept as dismissed and never reach the model. A source answering 429 rests a day; after 3 failures in a row it is switched off and reported in skipped; retire switches named sources off. Wakes the triage Soot only when enough new signals arrived since the last wake, at most once per wake_gap_hours (default 20), counted from the last wake the triage Soot answered (a wake the host refused counts nothing; the batch may wake again 6 h later), with at most 15 of the best new signals (the surplus is dismissed).

tools.name: signals_list
tools.title: Xem tín hiệu thị trường
tools.description: List market signals by state (default new, at most 15 at a time): ref, source, title, url, a short summary. For the radar triage.

tools.name: signals_mark
tools.title: Phân loại tín hiệu
tools.description: Triage signals in one call, all or nothing: kept (with a one-line note: the angle and why now), dismissed or used.

tools.name: video_stats
tools.title: Đọc số video TikTok/YouTube
tools.description: Read view, like, comment and repost counts of published TikTok and YouTube video posts (and optionally the latest videos of a channel handle) with yt-dlp, no login, into metrics. Without yt-dlp it says how to install it.

tools.name: inputs_health
tools.title: Xem đội còn thiếu gì
tools.description: Which inputs of the marketing stage are starving, in plain Vietnamese (Search Console, market signals, TikTok and YouTube numbers). Read-only; chain it into company-loop health_sync. posts.awareness is the 14-day mix of posts by awareness level (unaware, problem, choosing, chua_gan = untagged) with a one-line note when one nấc is over 70% of the tagged posts or a nấc has none while 5 or more were tagged.

tools.name: channels_setup
tools.title: Thiết lập kênh
tools.description: For a tool-only schedule: create missing channels (browser ones paused until signed in) and fill only unset caps, account, profile, rules, quiet hours, stale_after_h, the product name and the writer Soot. from_products adds a tiktok-<handle> channel per TikTok account in products.json. Never unpauses or overwrites an edit.

profile.description: Browser profile the Publisher drives; the claim carries it.

tools.name: raised
tools.title: Ghi đã hỏi bạn
tools.description: Mark due.needs items as filed with report_blocker (their key), so the dispatch schedule does not wake again for them.

tools.name: answer
tools.title: Làm theo câu trả lời của bạn
tools.description: The person picked an option on a due.ask item: pass its key and the option label exactly (with url when they sent the live link). It applies the pick; then file the next due.ask.

tools.name: replies_sync
tools.title: Đọc phản hồi
tools.description: For the replies schedule: read watched Reddit threads by RSS, drop reader handles after 30 days, list replies to classify and channels to read. wake/notify only when there is something to do.

tools.name: reply_save
tools.title: Lưu phản hồi
tools.description: Save replies the Publisher read on one social channel with their class: safe (answer via draft_save kind reply, check, schedule), complaint, money, account, flagged (never answered; one Cần bạn item each; account also gets the fixed support pointer as a draft) or spam (ignored). Marks the channel's notifications read.

tools.name: video_import
tools.title: Nhận video đã dựng
tools.description: Read a finished 2build marketing-video (mvf) folder in the workspace (pretest decision, Micro Fish judge numbers, 08-delivery files, QA, captions, poster, platform copy) and save one kind "video" draft per channel (X, Facebook, TikTok: the 9x16 cut with the platform's own caption; a TikTok draft carries the running campaign's TikTok link) with its assets. A render failure or a hook under the pretest bar stays a draft with the reason. Re-import updates the same drafts. Never publishes. Takes the session's result {request_id, campaign, channels, ...} (claude-code_watch emit "result"), or watch's emit "job" answer {job, result} / {job, notify} and records the job's end in the Claude Code ledger (settings.video_jobs, the desk's Nội dung): done with its drafts, or failed with the reason and the session's last words, answered {ok: false, notify: true, error: "job_failed: ..."}.

script.description: Script id; default the pretest winner.

parent.description: The source post (blog article) the video was cut from.

error.description: mvf's FAIL line when the render or export failed.

job.description: claude-code_watch's job (emit "job"): {id, key, title, state, error, last_text, ...}.

result.description: The session's result with emit "job": {request_id, campaign, channels, parent, ...}.

notify.description: Set by claude-code_watch on a failed job; ignored.

tools.name: video_brief
tools.title: Chọn bài để dựng video
tools.description: Tool-only, no model. Picks the next source for a video: the newest published article of the product that has no video yet on these channels, at most one brief per every_days for each product and video channel (a rerun the same day answers {done: true, reason}). With channels left out it covers every live TikTok account of the product, one brief per fire: the account whose turn is next. With work it answers exactly the input of claude-code_start: {key: "video-<product>-<slug>", title, dir (the repository that holds MARKETING_ROOT, where mvf runs), prompt}. The prompt tells Claude Code to read the 2build marketing-video skill (MVF_SKILL), make ONE short Vietnamese vertical video unattended (brief answered from the source, script approved as delegated after the Micro Fish pretest, nothing posted or committed) and write the result file {request_id, campaign, channels, parent}, which chains into marketing_video_import; on failure {ok: false, error}. Nothing to do: {done: true, reason}. A missing MARKETING_ROOT or skill is refused as not_configured; an unknown product, a missing video channel folder or a product with no TikTok account as not_found.

channels.description: The video channels the video is for, e.g. ["tiktok-acme", "facebook-acme"]; at most one TikTok account. Left out: every TikTok account of the product, in turn.

every_days.description: At most one brief per this many local days for each product and video channel; default 1.

source_state.description: The state a source article is in; default published.

tools.name: video_job
tools.title: Ghi việc Claude Code
tools.description: Tool-only, chained after claude-code_start with input_from previous: records the start's answer in the Claude Code ledger (settings.video_jobs) the desk's Nội dung shows. A started or already running job is running {id, key, title, started_at, log}; a busy answer (waiting: "busy") started nothing, so the entry is waiting and the brief's slot and source are freed for the next fire. Answers {ok: true, state, key}.

tools.name: campaign_save
tools.title: Lưu chiến dịch
tools.description: Create or update a campaign {name, goal{metric,target}, channels, starts, ends, token_budget}; makes one UTM short link per channel through the product api (PRODUCT_API_URL, needs PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY). Saving again fills links that failed.

tools.name: campaign_report
tools.title: Đọc số chiến dịch
tools.description: Read clicks and attributed signups per channel from the product api for running campaigns (or one id) and store them for Chiến dịch. Returns new signups as lead outcomes to record; with {id, tokens_used} also says when 80% of the token budget is used.

tools.name: campaign_verify
tools.title: Kiểm tra khoá chiến dịch
tools.description: Check the saved admin key with one read-only request: state ok, wrong_key or no_role.

tools.name: publish_bundle
tools.title: Lên lịch gói đăng
tools.description: Ask the founder ONCE for one source and everything made from it: the blog in each language and its social posts (gói đăng). The approval card shows every post with its words and about when it goes out. After Duyệt this only records the approved set; release_due publishes each post at its slot with the approved revision, and a post changed since is never published. Copy revision, title and text from cms_read / social_list (with no hub, from item_save: its revision, no ids). Community posts and newsletters go in the same bundle with title/subject and body; they, TikTok and posts saved with no hub become the founder's hand-offs after Duyệt. A post for a channel the product cannot post to is left out (skipped). Never call cms_publish or social_publish yourself.

id.description: social: the hub post id; leave it out for a post saved with no hub (it becomes the founder's hand-off).

revision.description: The revision the founder approves (the hub's, or item_save's revision for a part saved only as files); it must still be the latest when it goes out.

title.description: blog: the revision title, as cms_read returned it; community: the post title, as item_save saved it.

text.description: social: the queued text, exactly as social_list returned it.

not_before.description: Optional ISO time; the post goes at its channel's first slot after it.

body.description: community / newsletter: the body, exactly as item_save saved it.

tools.name: release_due
tools.title: Đăng bài đến giờ
tools.description: The tool-only schedule (every 5 minutes, no model): publishes the due posts of approved bundles through the hub with the approved revision, and writes approved blogs of a product without a hub blog into its site folder (state written). Re-checks revision and words first (a change holds it), writes an intent before each hub call or file, looks a lost answer up instead of sending again, holds a slot missed by more than 6 hours. notify is true only when a post newly needs the founder; then raise ONE report_blocker listing them.

tools.name: library_scan
tools.title: Quét thư mục marketing
tools.description: Refresh the desk's index of the marketing library (MARKETING_ROOT): items, video campaigns, radars, videos.csv. Lists hub blog posts that no library item names (hub_only: "chưa có tệp"). hub: false skips that hub read.

tools.name: file_read
tools.title: Đọc tệp trong thư mục marketing
tools.description: Read one text file (or list one folder) inside the marketing library (MARKETING_ROOT), read-only: products.json, <product>/brand.md, an item's files, a radar. path is relative to the library; no path lists the top folder. Refuses anything outside the library, a link that leaves it, hidden files and files over 256 KiB; long files come in pages (offset, max_chars, next_offset).

tools.name: item_save
tools.title: Lưu bài vào thư mục marketing
tools.description: The Writer's one save for a piece of content: writes content/<product>/<day>-<slug>/ (meta.json, <lang>.md, <channel>.<lang>.txt) AND the hub drafts (cms_save per language, social_queue/social_update per post). Saving the same text again changes nothing; a changed text moves the hub revision, so an approval in waiting no longer covers it. Pass ref when the desk gave one (Tạo nội dung). Use this instead of cms_save / social_queue.

reopen.description: Only when the founder asked to reopen an item stopped on the desk.

community.description: A community post (format community) or a launch's Show HN part: where, title and body.

newsletter.description: A newsletter (format newsletter). sending: true only when the Editor asked email to send the approved one.

pretest.description: A Micro Fish pre-test of this revision: asked, done (verdict go|fix|stop, n, score 0-10, up to 3 reasons), failed or unavailable.

waiting.description: The one question the team is waiting on the founder for (the same words as the report_blocker). The desk shows the item as Chờ bạn trả lời. null clears it once answered.

PRODUCT_API_URL.title: Địa chỉ API của sản phẩm
PRODUCT_API_URL.description: Địa chỉ máy chủ của sản phẩm mà đội đọc số liệu và nội dung. Ví dụ: https://api.example.com.

YT_DLP_BIN.title: Chương trình tải video
YT_DLP_BIN.description: Đường dẫn tới chương trình yt-dlp trên máy chủ, dùng để tải video tham khảo. Để trống thì dùng bản có sẵn trên máy.

MVF_SKILL.title: Kỹ năng dựng video (2build marketing-video)
MVF_SKILL.description: Đường dẫn tuyệt đối tới SKILL.md của kỹ năng marketing-video (2build) trên máy này, để việc dựng video tự động đọc nó. Để trống thì dùng <thư mục chứa thư mục marketing>/2build/skills/marketing-video/SKILL.md nếu có.

PRODUCT_AGENT_KEY.title: Khoá riêng của Soot này cho API sản phẩm
PRODUCT_AGENT_KEY.description: Khoá API mà trang quản trị sản phẩm của bạn tạo riêng cho Soot này, chỉ để tạo liên kết chiến dịch và đọc số lượt bấm, đăng ký theo chiến dịch. Chỉ gửi tới địa chỉ API của sản phẩm. Không dán khoá vào chat.

PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY.title: Khoá dùng chung (cũ, không cần nữa)
PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY.description: Khoá dùng chung đời cũ. Không cần nhập: khoá riêng của Soot này cho API sản phẩm đã thay nó; Soot chỉ dùng khoá cũ khi chưa có khoá riêng.

MARKETING_HUB.title: Máy chủ đăng bài
MARKETING_HUB.description: Kết nối tới Máy chủ đăng bài của bạn: các trang, kênh và quyền đăng của đội này. Lấy ở trang quản trị của Máy chủ đăng bài; nhập trong Nest, không nhập trong chat. Không có thì đội vẫn làm được: blog ghi vào thư mục site, bài mạng xã hội bạn đăng tay.

MARKETING_CLAIM_KEY.title: Khoá đăng bài của Máy chủ đăng bài
MARKETING_CLAIM_KEY.description: Khoá do Máy chủ đăng bài cấp cho đội này, để mỗi lượt đăng được ký và Máy đăng chỉ đăng đúng bài bạn đã duyệt. Chép từ trang quản trị của Máy chủ đăng bài; Máy đăng dùng cùng khoá này. Nhập trong Nest, không nhập trong chat.

FILE_ROOT.title: Thư mục làm việc
FILE_ROOT.description: Thư mục làm việc của cuộc trò chuyện, nơi để video đã dựng. Nest cấp tự động; công cụ nhận video chỉ đọc tệp trong thư mục này.

GSC_GOOGLE.title: Google Search Console
GSC_GOOGLE.description: Đăng nhập Google trong Nest để Soot đọc số hiển thị, lượt bấm và vị trí của các bài đã đăng (chỉ quyền đọc Search Console).

MARKETING_ROOT.title: Thư mục marketing
MARKETING_ROOT.description: Thư mục nơi bàn Marketing giữ sản phẩm, giọng văn, bài và danh sách người nhận bản tin; đội chỉ đọc và ghi trong thư mục này. Mặc định là thư mục riêng của đội; chọn thư mục khác nếu bạn muốn mở nó bằng Finder.
